guidebook.intro: Lakes, rivers, hills and forests, and how to look after them. Places take omu, aha and kuruga.

tips.title: Omu, aha and kuruga
body: **Omu** means in or into: **omu kibira** (in the forest). **Aha** means at or on: **aha musozi** (on the hill). **Kuruga** means from: **kuruga Nalubaale** (from Lake Victoria).

culture.title: Hills and lakes of Ankole
body: Ankole is rolling green hills, **emisozi**, with Lake Mburo to the east and the River Rwizi winding through Mbarara. Lake Victoria is **Nalubaale** and the Nile is **Kiyira**.
